sections.heading: Rooms of the house
sections.body: *La casa* (house) or *el apartamento* (apartment — *el departamento* in Mexico and Argentina, *el piso* in Spain). The rooms: *la sala* (living room), *la cocina* (kitchen), *el dormitorio* or *el cuarto* (bedroom — *la recámara* in Mexico), *el baño* (bathroom), *el comedor* (dining room), *el jardín* (garden, yard). Floors: *el primer piso* can mean the ground floor or the first floor up depending on the country.

sections.heading: Where things are
sections.body: Location uses *estar* + a preposition. Many are phrases ending in *de* — remember *de + el = del*.

head: Spanish
English
Example
rows: *Las llaves están encima de la cama.*
*El gato está debajo de la silla.*
*La cocina está al lado del comedor.*
*El carro está delante de la casa.*
*El jardín está detrás de la casa.*
*El perro está fuera de la casa.*

sections.heading: Describing your home
sections.body: Use *hay* for what there is and *tener* for what your home has: *Mi apartamento tiene dos dormitorios. En la sala hay un sofá y una mesa.* Use *ser* for what it's like (*Es grande y moderno*) and *estar* for where it is (*Está en el centro*).
